changes.section: 集体屏蔽、Balescu–Lenard 与多体碰撞的区别
changes.detail: Added Princeton AST554 Kunz IV.5.1-IV.5.4 citation next to dielectric-factor formula; MIT conceptual paragraph alone did not display this factor.

checks: Particle-number normalization gives f units s^3 m^-6; central-moment P and h have Pa and W/m^2; U=trace(P)/2 is valid beyond Maxwell equilibrium.
Lorentz phase-space flow is divergence-free; Vlasov characteristics, self-consistent charge/current and Maxwell continuity are consistent.
Maxwellian normalization, component variance, zero central heat flux and 3 theta=theta_parallel+2 theta_perp checked by Gaussian moments.
Integrated kinetic moments agree with UT equations 4.33-4.38. Internal energy equation follows subtracting flow energy; sum(Q_s+u_s dot R_s)=0 agrees with 4.30-4.32.
Kn and magnetization conditions kept distinct; vte/nu example independently recalculated.
Rutherford tan(chi/2)=b90/b agrees with UT 3.64; repulsive head-on r_min=2b90 follows energy conservation. 2pi b db times chi^2 produces coefficient 8pi and u^-3 scaling.
Coulomb logarithm uses explicit leading-log cutoffs; hbar/(mu u) defined as order-of-magnitude convention, so no spurious precision from the factor-of-two ambiguity.
nu_ei prefactor algebraically equals inverse UT 3.188. Reverse momentum frequency follows m_s n_s nu_ssprime symmetry, not the erroneous mass ratio in source 3.191.
Qi=3(me/mi)n nu(theta_e-theta_i) agrees with UT 4.82; heat capacities 3n/2 imply 2(me/mi)nu fixed-bath rate and 4(me/mi)nu evolving two-temperature difference rate.

Landau K coefficient equals gamma_ssprime/m_s^2 using UT 3.79,3.93,3.94. U dimensions s/m and K dimensions m^6/s^4 give C dimensions s^2/m^6. Maxwell bracket proportional to w, U w=0; pair prefactors satisfy m_s^2 K_ssprime=m_sprime^2 K_sprime_s.
FP coefficients retain the 1/2 convention, correct acceleration/diffusion units; fixed-background linear versus full nonlinear operator distinguished.
Heat conductivity in theta-gradient units is m^-1 s^-1; multiplying by kB produces W/(m K). Spitzer eta scale has ohm m units and is explicitly a scale rather than exact prefactor.

Balescu-Lenard dielectric factor and many-particle shielding versus binary correlation distinction checked against Princeton Kunz IV.5.1-5.4 and MIT transport notes p12; no full arbitrary-regime operator is claimed.

source_discrepancies_handled.detail: Last mass-ratio factor in displayed hierarchy conflicts with explicit 3.188 and 3.190; manuscript correctly derives nu_ie=(me/mi)nu_ei from momentum conservation and explicit times instead.

theory_review.evidence: Cold R/L signed denominators and -iD/+iD match UT equations5.31-5.39. Full Maxwell matrix checked. entries: 离子—离子混杂层与模转换加热
三离子方案的极化设计与实验边界
theory_review.evidence: IIH layer is distinguished from individual cyclotron frequency; mode conversion is energy transfer between modes before damping. entries: 从共振条件到可核验的吸收结论
theory_review.evidence: Peak phasor Q=.5Re(E†J); Hermitian conductivity equals omega epsilon0 times dissipative susceptibility. Direct real-field time quadrature for a complex nonsymmetric conductivity matches both tensor formulas. Stable cold collisionless response and causal singularities are distinguished.

engineering_review.entry: 波吸收、快离子分布与碰撞传能
engineering_review.evidence: f normalization and D_RF units give energy-moment unitsW. Independent Gaussian diffusion integration preserves number and yields power2mD n V=26761.9508152W for two perpendicular components, agreeing with integration by parts. Wave/FP equality requires same coordinates, normalization and boundaries; internal collisional exchange cancels in total plasma budget.
P=.5Re(VI*)=.5R|I_peak|²=R|I_RMS|²; peak and RMS phasors explicitly differentiated. Functional engineering chain not asserted as a fixed device configuration.

Gamma and forward-minus-reflected identity restricted to real positive reference impedance/same plane. S11 interpretation restricted to one excited port and other matched ports; multiport waves normalized to sqrtW. Accepted port power distinguished from line/metal/edge losses and core absorption; mutual exclusion prevents double counting.

engineering_review.entry: RF 鞘层、近场与杂质释放
engineering_review.evidence: Line-integrated parallel RF field is a drive proxy, not assumed equal to rectified DC voltage; nearfield/sheath and core resonance treated separately. Case-specific optimal antenna balance not copied as a general prescription.
No-reflection-threshold violation is not treated as proof of no internal arc; load tolerance and dedicated arc diagnostics separated. No unsupported universal hardware thresholds supplied.
Conservation, convergence, and experimental validation separated. Modulation and synthetic diagnostic limitations preserved; low-power and dummy-load tests do not claim validation of plasma coupling.

limitations: Numerical tests cover the explicitly listed benchmarks, not every statement in the knowledge base.
Prescribed spatially uniform RF electric field and static B; nonrelativistic, collisionless test particle, no self-consistent fields or radiation.
Resonant t-squared growth is a finite-time ideal initial-value result, not an unlimited practical heating law.
B(R)=B0 R0/R is an assumed vacuum-toroidal magnitude approximation; Doppler layer roots do not include orbit width, poloidal field, equilibrium changes, or damping.
Port acceptance and circuit losses do not establish core deposition, minority heating, species partition, or device efficiency.
CODATA mass ratios are a consistency route, not statistically independent constants measurements.
